usage: 陶瓷 (tou4 ci4) is a noun referring to ceramic material or products made from it.
It is commonly used to describe items made from fired clay, like dishes or tiles.
You can use 陶瓷 to talk about both raw material and finished goods.
In sentences, 陶瓷 often functions as the subject or object.
陶瓷 can be combined with other words to specify types, like 陶瓷杯 (ceramic cup).

examples.meaning: This ceramic cup is very beautiful.
